claims.statement: Pages usage source prohibits treating it as free business/e-commerce/commercial-SaaS hosting and warns against sensitive password/payment transactions. Terms-linked content restrictions are source references, not a current legal clearance decision or publication authority.

One user/organization site per account; source repository 1 GB is recommended, published site <=1 GB is a size limit, and deployment longer than ten minutes times out. Preserve source/published/deployment units and normative strengths.

FPT/GHEC bandwidth 100 GB/month and ten builds/hour are soft limits. Custom Actions build/publish is excluded from the ten-build limit, not automatically from bandwidth, size or timeout limits; GHES cloud soft limits are not asserted.

Cloud rate limits may yield 429 with explanatory HTML; exceeding quota may prevent serving or prompt Support mitigation suggestions including CDN/releases/other hosting. These are possible outcomes, not automatic remediation or authorization for costs.

GHEC managed-user Pages publishing is organization-repository-only, always private without visibility change, and cannot use organization-name.github.io organization sites. This is not a total ban on organization-owned project sites.

Educational website copies are not prohibited in this source only with self-written code, no user-data collection, prominent educational/nonassociation disclaimer and Terms compliance. This does not grant rights to copied content, trademarks or current legal clearance.
Pages hosts static HTML/CSS/JavaScript from a repository with optional build; example collection is illustrative, not independently reviewed deployable code or actual site behavior.

User/organization site source repository is owner.github.io with one site/account; project site source is a folder in project repository with one site/repository. These types and limits are distinct; no consumer repository rename/restructure is authorized.
FPT/GHEC public default paths are owner.github.io or owner.github.io/repository. GHEC private-site URLs differ; the default table must not be treated as private-site endpoint authority.

GHES isolation enabled uses pages.hostname/owner or /owner/repository; disabled uses hostname/pages/username for user site and /owner/repository for project. Preserve the table username-versus-owner terminology and resolve actual site identity independently.

Cloud custom domains are a capability subject to separate configuration/domain verification review. FPT visitor IP security logging occurs even without login; platform logging is separate from educational exercise's ban on the site's own user-data collection, not a guarantee of no data handling.

Product include makes Pages public-repository available for Free user/Free team and public/private repository available for Pro/Team/GHEC/GHES. Repository visibility support does not prove published-site privacy; no site published, domain/credentials changed, rights cleared or native protection verified.
